scenario: Direct matches + comparison flip on actionable nodes
description: Real subset of abdomen-ct/findings_{gt,pred}/example_1. Demonstrates clean alignment on near-synonymous descriptions of renal cysts and hepatic veins, a comparison flip on the mesenteric lymph node cluster (gt 'unchanged compared to prior' vs pred 'worsening compared to prior') that flows to Stage 3a deterministic, and a direct match on portal vein narrowing.

pred_findings.text: Multiple small hypodense lesions in both kidneys, likely representing cysts.
Three mesenteric lymph nodes measuring up to 12 mm, worsening compared to prior CT.
Portal vein shows approximately 50-60% narrowing at the porta hepatis.

gt_findings.text: Multiple subcentimeter hypodense lesions in the bilateral kidneys, likely small cysts.
Three mesenteric lymph nodes measuring up to 12 mm, unchanged compared to prior CT.
Main portal vein demonstrates approximately 60% luminal narrowing at the porta hepatis.

matches.reasoning: Both completeness statements about patent hepatic veins.
Same finding (bilateral renal hypodense lesions, characterized as cysts); descriptors differ slightly but anatomy + pathology entity match.
Same finding (three 12 mm mesenteric lymph nodes); comparison differs (worsening vs stable) but anatomy + count + size match — Stage 3a will flag the comparison disagreement.
Same finding (portal vein luminal narrowing at the porta hepatis); pred reports a range, gt reports a single value.
